title: Esther Speaks Up
summary: In Esther Speaks Up, kids slow down long enough to see the choice, pressure, or promise inside the passage. Courage can mean using your place to help people in danger. Esther risked speaking up to help her people.

read_it.prompt: Read Esther 4:10-16 and underline the part that best shows courage.

tell_it: Esther risked speaking up to help her people. Esther was afraid to go to the king, but she chose courage to help her people. Mordecai reminded her that her moment mattered.
understand_it: Courage can mean using your place to help people in danger. Esther Speaks Up gives children a way to connect the Bible event to choices they actually face.
age_5_7_explanation: Esther risked speaking up to help her people.
age_8_11_explanation: Esther was afraid to go to the king, but she chose courage to help her people. Mordecai reminded her that her moment mattered. Kids can notice courage in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Courage can mean using your place to help people in danger.
teen_explanation: Courage can mean using your place to help people in danger. When silence would be easier, Esther's courage helps kids think about using their voice for what is right. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Courage can mean using your place to help people in danger.
Esther Speaks Up shows courage through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When silence would be easier, Esther's courage helps kids think about using their voice for what is right.
life_application: When silence would be easier, Esther's courage helps kids think about using their voice for what is right.

discussion_questions: What happened first in Esther Speaks Up, and what changed by the end?

activity.title: For Such a Time Crown
activity.instructions: Make a paper crown and write one situation where courage could help someone else.

prayer_prompt: Father, help me see what Esther Speaks Up teaches and practice courage in a real choice this week.
